_comment: bitGen Studio 3.4.0 - PlatoKeys (github.com/Nynxz/ComfyUI-PlatoKeys, Apache-2.0): which style text encoders a lighter encoder can stand in for, through a key in ComfyUI/models/plato_keys. Read by lib/platoKeys.js (the Basic Settings list) AND scripts/plato_keys_apply.py (the graph a render sends) - one set of rules. families: a CLIPLoader whose type is in 'types' and whose clip_name matches 'native' is that family's own encoder; a key belongs to the family when its target part (after _to_, or the whole name for a key without _to_) holds one of 'target'. skip: keys never picked (ablations). sourceType: the CLIPLoader type a key's source encoder loads as with the official PlatoKeys nodes (calibrate_comfy.py's default --source-clip-type is qwen_image); a family's own type is kept for a key the PlatosKeyPatchCLIP node uses.
